h:
Pull out any prophecy chart from the last 50 years.

You’ll see Israel (highlighted), Russia, Europe, China, and the Middle East.

Now find Africa.

What do you see?

If you’re lucky, it’s a gray mass with “Egypt” in the corner. More likely? It’s blank space. Unlabeled. Erased.

760 million Christians.
The largest Christian population on earth.
The fastest-growing church globally.

Doesn’t even get a label.

The Question Nobody’s Asking

If end-times prophecy is about the CHURCH, the BRIDE, the REMNANT...
Then why is the entire prophetic framework centered on:

  • A secular state established in 1948
  • Western superpowers
  • Regions with DECLINING Christianity

While completely ignoring:

  • 760 million African Christians
  • Believers facing ACTUAL martyrdom (7,000+ killed in Nigeria this year)
  • Indigenous, Spirit-led revivals across the continent

Why does every prophecy conference obsess over Israeli politics...
...while African believers are literally dying for their faith?

The Uncomfortable Answer

Western prophecy teaching isn’t about BIBLICAL truth. It’s about:

  1. Western Supremacy - We center ourselves in the story
  2. Financial Interests - Israel teaching is profitable (tours, books, donations)
  3. Political Alignment - Serves Western geopolitical goals
  4. Media Control - Same voices, same narrative, endlessly amplified
  5. Theological Convenience - Admitting we’re wrong is hard

What Scripture Actually Says

Africa is ALL OVER the Bible:

Cush/Ethiopia mentioned 40+ times

Psalm 68:31: “Cush shall stretch out her hands to God”

Isaiah 18: Entire chapter about Ethiopia bringing tribute to Zion

The Ethiopian eunuch (Acts 8) - one of the FIRST Gentile converts

But prophecy charts? Blank space.

What If We’re Watching the Wrong Location?

The “woman in the wilderness” (Rev 12) - protected in Africa for millennia

Gog/Magog - attacking African Christianity RIGHT NOW?

Western Christianity - becoming the apostate Babylon?

The numbers don’t lie: 760 million African Christians vs. 9 million Israelis
Fastest-growing church vs. declining Western Christianity
Actual martyrdom vs. speculative tribulation

The Choice

Option 1: Keep watching Israel, ignore the martyrs, follow the money.

Option 2: Question everything. Follow the actual global body of Christ. Be willing to admit Western theology might be backwards.

Revelation 3:17-18 says we’re blind and don’t know it.

Maybe it’s time to get new maps.
